Hasan Heib, son of Lobna and Kamel, was born on 26 November 2005 in Rumat Heib. He is the brother of Heba, Ekram, Hiba, Mohammed and Mahmoud.

Hasan grew up in the village of Rumat Heib in the Beit Netofa Valley. He studied at the village schools, where he stood out as a diligent and curious student. His big dream was to study veterinary medicine.

He was a sociable boy and very well known in the village. He liked to visit the homes of his many friends and to go out with them.

On Shabbat, 22 Tishrei, Simchat Torah 5784, 7 October 2023, at half past six in the morning, the terror organization Hamas launched a surprise attack on Israel from the Gaza Strip. That morning, a war began.

Hasan completed his high school studies a few months before the war broke out and was a candidate for national service (Mash"av). His father tried to persuade him to learn to drive a truck so that he could serve in the army as a transport driver, but Hasan was determined to be a combat soldier. For this reason, he chose to enroll in a pre-military preparatory program for Bedouin combat soldiers, a framework that combines preparation for military service with a personal and group process of identity formation, and the development of leadership and social responsibility.

From the earliest stages of his studies at the program, Hasan stood out for his exceptional abilities. He showed unusual determination, self-discipline and a strong desire to succeed and advance. Alongside his personal achievements, he was a source of strength and an anchor for his friends. He earned the trust of those around him and soon became a leading figure in the group.

On 9 May 2024, he enlisted in the IDF and served in the Border Defense Corps. After training, he was posted to the Menashe Regional Brigade. Hasan integrated well, both professionally and socially, and earned the appreciation of his commanders. He felt satisfaction and pride, and more than once chose to give up his leave in order to take part in various activities.

Staff Sergeant Hasan Heib fell while carrying out his duties during the war on 16 December 2025. He was 20 years old. He was laid to rest in the cemetery in Ein al-Heib. He is survived by his parents and five brothers and sisters.

His instructor from the pre-military program, Shiran, eulogized him: "Yesterday a hero was killed, a combat soldier. I lost a trainee, I lost him. The heart refuses to understand, the soul refuses to accept. Hasan Heib, may his memory be blessed. An outstanding combat soldier. A person who does not need to say much to lead, a quiet leadership, a deep presence and a way that is felt in every step.

Hasan began with me as a trainee in the pre-military program for Bedouin combat soldiers... From the first moment he stood before me I knew that he was a different kind of person. I looked into his eyes and I knew: this is a trainee I would want beside me in any fight, in life and in joy. An amazing person, pure, principled, the kind you want beside you in moments of truth. I had the privilege of preparing him for meaningful service, a privilege that is not taken for granted... To me, you are a hero. Not because you asked, but because you did. Not because you spoke, but because you acted. You gave your soul for the state, and this price is the highest of all. Hasan Heib, may his memory be blessed, you walked quietly, but you left a deep, strong mark that will never be erased. May his memory be blessed. Forever in our hearts."
